title: The Wolf of Ashvale Revisited
author: Ines Lockridge
blurb: Emrys Nystrom, a thief who steals memories, has spent twelve years selling small charms in a city that outlawed magic. But when a child arrives at the door speaking a language that predates kingdoms, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, she must steal back a soul sold to the court beneath the mountain before the last dragon-fire gutters out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
